about.title: About the Battle Styles set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Battle Styles is a Sword & Shield expansion released on 19 March 2021. It has 183 cards: 163 in the main set and 20 secret rares. There are also 123 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 163 main set cards), the Master set (286 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 306 cards, adding the 20 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
